$comment: Hero backdrop and feature carousel. Paths are relative to the site root (this repository's root at build time). Encode a recording with scripts/encode-clip.mjs and edit only this file; see README.md 'Replacing media'. A slide with "hidden": true is left out of the page (its files need not exist).

stage.$comment: The hero's depth stage: player windows fanned in 3D. "center" is the front window, whose clip plays; "near" are the windows beside it (left, right); "far" are pre-blurred stills for the back row (left, right), made with `npm run encode -- --far <slide-id | poster path> [--id <name>]`. A center or near entry is a slide id (that slide's clip, poster and area), a card of its own ({"poster", "sources"} from `npm run encode`, over the frame's client area or the "area" it names; or with "frame": a narrowed window from `npm run encode -- --window <width> --id <name>`, its picture under the title bar, for a cut without the playlist pane), or (near only) a still: a .webp path, or a card without "sources". The center window uses the main frame. Near clips start once the front window's clip plays, on wide screens only; reduced motion or Save-Data shows the posters only.

caption.en: In fullscreen, slide the pointer to the right edge: picture, audio, subtitles and playback open beside the video, and every change applies as it plays. Any command is a few letters away in the Command Palette.
caption.zh-Hans: 全屏时把指针滑到屏幕右缘，画面、音频、字幕与播放的面板就在视频旁展开，播放中即时生效。命令面板里敲几个字母，任何命令都触手可及。

title.en: A playlist that shows its films
title.zh-Hans: 看得见画面的播放列表

caption.en: Every item carries a thumbnail taken from the film itself, made on your own machine. Hide them for a compact list and bring them back with one click.
caption.zh-Hans: 每一项都带着取自影片本身、在本机生成的缩略图。一键隐藏即成紧凑列表，再一键换回来。

title.en: Add features from the Plugin Store

caption.en: Open the store from the bottom bar and install a plugin such as VestraTube: it appears in the player right away.
caption.zh-Hans: 在底部栏打开插件商城，安装 VestraTube 等插件，装好立刻出现在播放器里。

title.en: Describe a plugin, and AI builds it
title.zh-Hans: 说出想要的插件，AI 帮你做

caption.en: Tell Vestra Player AI what you want in plain words. It writes and tests the plugin, and one click installs it. Works with your own AI provider key.
caption.zh-Hans: 用一句话告诉 Vestra Player AI 你想要什么，它会编写并测试插件，一键即可安装。使用你自己的 AI 服务密钥。

caption.en: A plugin can be a whole emulator. Load a ROM from the Games menu and play with the keyboard.
caption.zh-Hans: 插件甚至可以是一个完整的模拟器。从“游戏”菜单加载 ROM，用键盘就能玩。
